pendingApplications.address: Land South Of West Street And West Of Loose Lane Sompting West Sussex
pendingApplications.proposal: Application for Approval of Reserved Matters for Phase 3 following hybrid planning permission AWDM/0323/19. Details regarding the scale, layout, appearance, access and landscaping for the erection of 278 dwellings (including 30% affordable housing), a pocket park, LEAP and public open space, and car parking. Includes the submission of details pursuant to Conditions 15 (CEMP), 16 (bat sensitive lighting strategy), 18 (noise), 20 (cycle parking), 21 (car parking), 23 (waste and refuse), 27 (sustainability), 31 (nature conservation), 32 (external materials) and 36 (boundary treatments) of AWDM/0323/19.
